purpose: Describe a change continuing in one direction.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
Change verb dictionary form + 一方だ
I keep forgetting words I do not use.
Even after repairs, the machine keeps getting worse.
formation: Change verb dictionary form + 一方だ
restrictions: Use with verbs of change; commonly, but not always, an unwelcome trend.
mistake: It describes an ongoing trend rather than two contrasting sides.
